description:
Required Skills: 
 Requires a bachelor's degree in a related area and 2-4 years of experience.
 We are looking for a mid-senior level developer to write RESTful API’s and build microservices in node.js on the Hapi platform for the company to Go Team, which is rebuilding its software infrastructure from scratch.
 Experience with Hapi, docker, virtualized large scale environments, dev-ops, and/or participation in open source projects (or at least interest in them) is a plus.
 Designs, modifies, develops, writes and implements software programming applications.
 Supports and/or installs software applications/operating systems.
 Participates in the testing process through test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software.


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ months  
 Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
